garmin:LUNGE:ALTERNATING_BARBELL_FORWARD.summary: Alternate forward lunges while supporting a barbell across your upper back.
steps: Stand tall with the barbell securely across your upper back and feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot forward and plant it firmly.
Lower until both knees are bent, keeping your torso upright.
Drive through the front foot to return to standing.
Repeat with the opposite leg and continue alternating.
garmin:LUNGE:ALTERNATING_BARBELL_FORWARD.safetyNote: Keep the front knee aligned with the toes and maintain a braced, neutral spine.

garmin:LUNGE:ALTERNATING_DUMBBELL_LUNGE_.summary: Alternate forward lunges while reaching the dumbbell forward to challenge the legs, shoulders, and core.
steps: Stand tall holding a dumbbell securely with both hands near your chest.
Step one foot forward into a lunge.
Lower with control while extending the dumbbell forward at shoulder height.
Bring the dumbbell back toward your chest and push through the front foot to stand.
Repeat on the opposite side and continue alternating.
garmin:LUNGE:ALTERNATING_DUMBBELL_LUNGE_.safetyNote: Use a manageable load and avoid rounding your back during the reach.

garmin:PLYO:ALTERNATING_JUMP_LUNGE.summary: Explosively jump between alternating split-lunge positions using only body weight.
steps: Begin in a split stance and lower into a controlled lunge.
Drive through both feet and jump vertically.
Switch your legs while airborne.
Land softly in the opposite split stance with both knees bent.
Immediately stabilize or continue alternating for the prescribed repetitions.
garmin:PLYO:ALTERNATING_JUMP_LUNGE.safetyNote: Land quietly with your knees tracking over your toes, and stop if control deteriorates.

claude.summary: A backward (reverse) lunge performed while wearing a weighted ruck pack.
steps: Wear a loaded ruck on your back and stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot backward and lower until both knees reach about 90 degrees.
Push through the front heel to return to standing.
Repeat, alternating or completing reps per side as programmed.
claude.safetyNote: Keep the torso upright and core braced to manage the added load on the spine.

garmin:LUNGE:BACK_FOOT_ELEVATED_DUMBBELL.summary: Perform a dumbbell split squat with the rear foot elevated behind you.
steps: Stand in a split stance holding the dumbbells at your sides and place the top of your rear foot on a stable elevation.
Position the front foot far enough forward to descend comfortably.
Bend both knees and lower your hips while keeping most of your weight over the front leg.
Pause before the rear knee reaches the floor.
Drive through the front foot to return to the starting position, then complete the other side.
garmin:LUNGE:BACK_FOOT_ELEVATED_DUMBBELL.safetyNote: Ensure the rear-foot support is stable and keep the front knee aligned with the foot.

claude.summary: A lunge performed against resistance from an elastic band.
steps: Anchor a band and hold it or stand on it to create tension.
Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Step into a lunge, lowering until both knees are near 90 degrees.
Push through the front heel to return against the band's resistance.
Repeat for the prescribed reps and legs.
claude.safetyNote: Keep the band securely anchored so it does not slip and cause a loss of balance.

codex.summary: Perform a forward lunge onto a box while supporting a barbell across your upper back.
steps: Stand facing a stable box with the barbell securely across your upper back.
Step one foot forward onto the box and plant the entire foot.
Bend the front knee and lower into a lunge while keeping your torso upright.
Drive through the elevated foot to return to the floor.
Complete the repetitions on each side as prescribed.
codex.safetyNote: Use a box height and barbell load that let you keep the whole lead foot planted securely.

claude.summary: A lunge with a barbell on the back where the front foot steps onto or the rear leg drops from a box.
steps: Rest a barbell across your upper back and stand facing or beside a box.
Step so one foot is on the box, lowering into a lunge.
Keep the torso upright as the rear knee lowers.
Push through the elevated foot to return to standing.
Repeat for reps, then switch legs.
claude.safetyNote: Ensure the box is stable and step securely to avoid slipping off the edge.

garmin:LUNGE:BARBELL_BULGARIAN_SPLIT_SQU.summary: Perform a rear-foot-elevated split squat with a barbell across your upper back.
steps: Place the barbell securely across your upper back and stand in front of a stable elevation.
Extend one leg behind you and rest the top of that foot on the elevation.
Bend both knees to lower your hips while keeping your torso controlled.
Descend until the front thigh approaches parallel or your comfortable range ends.
Drive through the front foot to stand, then complete the other side.
garmin:LUNGE:BARBELL_BULGARIAN_SPLIT_SQU.safetyNote: Keep the front knee aligned with the toes and use a stable rear-foot support.

codex.summary: Lunge one leg diagonally behind and across the other while supporting a barbell across your upper back.
steps: Stand tall with the barbell securely across your upper back.
Step one foot diagonally behind and across your standing leg.
Bend both knees and lower your hips under control.
Press through the front foot to return to standing.
Complete the repetitions on each side as prescribed.
codex.safetyNote: Keep the front knee tracking with the toes and use only a crossover distance you can control.

claude.summary: A curtsy-style lunge with a barbell where one leg crosses behind the other.
steps: Rest a barbell across your upper back and stand with feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot diagonally behind and across the other leg.
Lower until both knees are bent and the rear knee nears the floor.
Push through the front heel to return to standing.
Repeat for reps, then switch sides.
claude.safetyNote: Move under control to keep balance as the legs cross behind.

claude.summary: A split squat performed with a barbell held in the front-rack position.
steps: Hold a barbell in the front-rack position across the front of your shoulders.
Set one foot forward and one back in a staggered stance.
Lower straight down until the front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Drive through the front heel to return to the start.
Complete all reps, then switch legs.
claude.safetyNote: Keep the elbows high and torso upright so the bar stays secure on the shoulders.

garmin:LUNGE:BARBELL_SIDE_LUNGE.summary: Step laterally into a lunge while supporting a barbell across your upper back.
steps: Stand tall with the barbell securely across your upper back and feet together or hip-width apart.
Take a wide step directly to one side.
Bend the stepping knee and push your hips back while keeping the other leg straight.
Drive through the stepping foot to return to standing.
Complete the repetitions on each side as prescribed.
garmin:LUNGE:BARBELL_SIDE_LUNGE.safetyNote: Keep the bending knee aligned with its toes and maintain a braced, neutral spine.

garmin:LUNGE:BARBELL_SPLIT_SQUAT.summary: Lower and raise your body from a stationary split stance with a barbell across your upper back.
steps: Place the barbell securely across your upper back and take a comfortable split stance.
Keep both feet planted and your torso upright.
Bend both knees to lower the rear knee toward the floor.
Drive through the front foot to return to the starting height.
Complete the repetitions before switching legs.
garmin:LUNGE:BARBELL_SPLIT_SQUAT.safetyNote: Keep the front knee aligned with the toes and maintain stable foot contact.

codex.summary: Create alternating battle-rope waves while moving between lunges.
steps: Stand facing the rope anchor with one end in each hand and enough slack to form waves.
Begin making alternating up-and-down arm waves.
Step one foot into a lunge while maintaining the alternating waves.
Drive back to standing without stopping the rope motion.
Lunge with the opposite leg and continue alternating.
codex.safetyNote: Keep your torso braced and choose a pace that preserves knee alignment and steady rope control.

claude.summary: A conditioning move combining alternating battle-rope waves with alternating lunges.
steps: Hold one battle rope end in each hand and stand facing the anchor.
Begin making alternating waves with the ropes.
Step into a lunge with one leg while continuing the waves.
Return to standing and lunge with the opposite leg.
Continue alternating lunges and waves for the set duration.
claude.safetyNote: Keep the core braced and back neutral to manage the combined arm and leg effort.

claude.summary: A reverse (rear) lunge emphasizing controlled core and torso stability.
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and core braced.
Step one foot backward, lowering until both knees are near 90 degrees.
Maintain an upright, stable torso throughout the descent.
Push through the front heel to return to standing.
Repeat, alternating or per side as programmed.
claude.safetyNote: Move slowly and keep the core engaged to maintain balance and protect the spine.

codex.summary: Step forward and outward on a diagonal into a body-weight lunge.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot forward and outward at roughly a 45-degree angle.
Bend the stepping knee and lower your hips while keeping the trailing foot planted.
Drive through the stepping foot to return to standing.
Repeat on the other side as prescribed.
codex.safetyNote: Keep the stepping knee aligned with the direction of the foot.

claude.summary: A bodyweight lunge stepping out on a diagonal angle rather than straight forward.
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot forward and out at roughly a 45-degree angle.
Lower until both knees are bent near 90 degrees.
Push through the front heel to return to standing.
Repeat for reps, then switch legs.
claude.safetyNote: Keep the front knee tracking over the foot as you step at the angle.

claude.summary: A lunge holding dumbbells where the front foot steps onto or the rear leg drops from a box.
steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand near a box.
Step so one foot is on the box, lowering into a lunge.
Keep the torso upright as the rear knee lowers.
Push through the elevated foot to return to standing.
Repeat for reps, then switch legs.
claude.safetyNote: Ensure the box is stable and step securely to avoid slipping off the edge.

codex.summary: Lunge one leg diagonally behind and across the other while holding dumbbells.
steps: Stand tall holding the dumbbells at your sides.
Step one foot diagonally behind and across your standing leg.
Bend both knees and lower your hips under control.
Press through the front foot to return to standing.
Complete the repetitions on each side as prescribed.
codex.safetyNote: Keep the front knee tracking with the toes and avoid twisting your planted foot.

claude.summary: A curtsy-style lunge with dumbbells where one leg crosses behind the other.
steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand with feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot diagonally behind and across the other leg.
Lower until both knees bend and the rear knee nears the floor.
Push through the front heel to return to standing.
Repeat for reps, then switch sides.
claude.safetyNote: Move under control to maintain balance as the legs cross behind.

codex.summary: Step forward and outward on a diagonal into a lunge while holding dumbbells.
steps: Stand tall holding the dumbbells at your sides.
Step one foot forward and outward at roughly a 45-degree angle.
Bend the stepping knee and lower your hips with control.
Drive through the stepping foot to return to standing.
Repeat on the other side as prescribed.
codex.safetyNote: Keep the stepping knee aligned with the foot and prevent the dumbbells from swinging.

claude.summary: A lunge with dumbbells stepping out on a diagonal angle.
steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand with feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot forward and out at roughly a 45-degree angle.
Lower until both knees are bent near 90 degrees.
Push through the front heel to return to standing.
Repeat for reps, then switch legs.
claude.safetyNote: Keep the front knee tracking over the foot as you step at the angle.

codex.summary: Combine a neutral-grip dumbbell curl, lunge, and overhead press into one controlled sequence.
steps: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing inward.
Curl the dumbbells toward your shoulders without swinging.
Step into a lunge and lower under control while keeping the dumbbells at shoulder level.
Drive through the front foot to stand and press both dumbbells overhead.
Lower the dumbbells with control, return your arms to your sides, and alternate the lunging leg.
codex.safetyNote: Use a load that allows a neutral spine and controlled overhead press throughout the sequence.

claude.summary: A combination move linking a dumbbell hammer curl, a lunge, and an overhead press.
steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with a neutral grip.
Perform a hammer curl, bringing the dumbbells to shoulder height.
Step into a lunge, lowering until both knees are near 90 degrees.
As you rise from the lunge, press the dumbbells overhead.
Lower the weights and repeat the sequence for reps.
claude.safetyNote: Keep the core braced and press without overarching the lower back.

garmin:LUNGE:DUMBBELL_LUNGE_AND_ROTATION.summary: A dumbbell lunge combined with torso rotation trains the legs, glutes, and obliques.
steps: Stand upright holding a dumbbell securely in front of your torso.
Step forward into a lunge and lower both knees under control.
Keeping your hips stable, rotate your torso toward the forward leg.
Rotate back to center and push through the front foot to stand.
Repeat on the opposite side.
garmin:LUNGE:DUMBBELL_LUNGE_AND_ROTATION.safetyNote: Keep the front knee aligned with the toes and rotate through the upper torso without forcing the lower back.

garmin:LUNGE:DUMBBELL_OVERHEAD_BULGARIAN.summary: This rear-foot-elevated split squat is performed while holding a dumbbell overhead.
steps: Stand in a split stance with the rear foot supported on a stable raised surface.
Press the dumbbell overhead and keep the arm steady.
Bend both knees to lower your hips while keeping most of your weight over the front leg.
Pause when you reach a controlled depth.
Drive through the front foot to return to standing, then complete the other side.
garmin:LUNGE:DUMBBELL_OVERHEAD_BULGARIAN.safetyNote: Use a manageable load and stop if you cannot keep the dumbbell stable overhead.

garmin:LUNGE:DUMBBELL_OVERHEAD_WALKING_L.summary: A walking lunge performed with a dumbbell held overhead challenges the legs, shoulders, and balance.
steps: Stand tall and press a dumbbell overhead with a stable arm.
Step forward and lower into a lunge until both knees are comfortably bent.
Push through the front foot and bring the rear leg forward.
Continue directly into the next lunge with the opposite leg.
Alternate legs while keeping the dumbbell overhead.
garmin:LUNGE:DUMBBELL_OVERHEAD_WALKING_L.safetyNote: Keep the ribs controlled and the weight vertically above the shoulder rather than drifting forward.

garmin:LUNGE:DUMBBELL_REVERSE_LUNGE_TO_H.summary: This combination links a dumbbell reverse lunge with a forward high-knee drive and overhead press.
steps: Stand upright holding the dumbbell at shoulder height.
Step one leg backward and lower into a reverse lunge.
Push through the front foot as you bring the rear leg forward into a high-knee position.
Press the dumbbell overhead while balancing on the standing leg.
Lower the dumbbell with control and repeat before changing sides.
garmin:LUNGE:DUMBBELL_REVERSE_LUNGE_TO_H.safetyNote: Choose a light load and regain stable balance before completing the overhead press.

codex.summary: A deep forward lunge with the elbow reaching toward the inside of the front foot mobilizes the hips and upper back.
steps: Stand tall, then take a long step forward.
Lower into a deep lunge and place the opposite hand beside the front foot for support.
Reach the elbow on the same side as the front leg toward the inside of that foot.
Pause briefly while keeping the rear leg extended comfortably.
Return to standing and repeat on the other side.
codex.safetyNote: Work only within a pain-free range and do not force the elbow toward the floor.

claude.summary: A bodyweight mobility lunge in which the front-side elbow drops toward the instep of the lead foot.
steps: Step forward into a deep lunge with the front foot flat.
Place both hands on the floor inside the front foot.
Lower the same-side elbow toward the instep of the front foot and hold briefly.
Return the hand to the floor and press back up to standing.
Repeat on the other side.
claude.safetyNote: Ease into the stretch gradually and avoid forcing the elbow down.

codex.summary: A barbell split squat with the front foot elevated increases the available range of motion at the hip and knee.
steps: Place the front foot securely on a low box and take a split stance with the barbell supported across the upper back.
Brace your torso and keep both feet planted.
Bend both knees and lower the rear knee toward the floor.
Descend only as far as you can maintain control and front-foot contact.
Drive through the elevated front foot to rise, then complete the other side.
codex.safetyNote: Use a stable box and keep the front knee tracking in line with the toes.

claude.summary: A split squat with the front foot raised on a box, loaded with a barbell across the upper back.
steps: Rest a barbell across your upper back and place your front foot on a low box.
Set the rear foot back into a staggered split stance.
Lower by bending the front knee, letting the hips drop below the box level.
Drive through the front foot to return to the start.
Complete the set, then switch legs.
claude.safetyNote: Keep the torso upright and the front knee stable; use a rack or spotter for the barbell if needed.

codex.summary: A farmer's carry walking lunge combines alternating forward lunges with dumbbells held at the sides.
steps: Stand tall holding a dumbbell at each side with a firm neutral grip.
Step forward and lower into a controlled lunge.
Push through the front foot and bring the rear leg forward.
Continue into the next lunge with the opposite leg.
Alternate sides while keeping the dumbbells steady and your torso upright.
codex.safetyNote: Avoid letting the weights swing or pull your shoulders and torso out of alignment.

claude.summary: Walking lunges performed while carrying a dumbbell in each hand at the sides.
steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at arm's length by your sides with shoulders back.
Step forward into a lunge, lowering both knees toward 90 degrees.
Drive through the front foot to stand and bring the rear leg forward.
Step immediately into the next lunge with the opposite leg.
Continue for the prescribed distance, keeping the weights steady.
claude.safetyNote: Keep the spine tall and grip firm; do not let the shoulders round forward under load.

codex.safetyNote: The proprietary name does not identify the dumbbell and arm sequence unambiguously.

garmin:POSE:HIGH_LUNGE.summary: High Lunge Pose is a standing yoga posture with the front knee bent, rear leg extended, and torso lifted.
steps: From standing, step one foot far back and keep the rear heel lifted.
Bend the front knee over the ankle while extending the rear leg.
Square the hips toward the front as comfortably as possible.
Lift the torso and reach both arms overhead.
Hold with steady breathing, then repeat with the other leg forward.
garmin:POSE:HIGH_LUNGE.safetyNote: Shorten the stance or lower the arms if balance or back comfort is limited.

codex.safetyNote: The name does not specify the lunge direction or dumbbell pulling pattern clearly enough.

claude.summary: A lunge combined with a single-arm dumbbell row mimicking a lawnmower pull.
steps: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and step forward into a lunge, hinging slightly at the hips.
Let the dumbbell hang toward the floor near the front foot.
Row the dumbbell up toward the hip, driving the elbow back.
Lower the dumbbell and press back to standing.
Repeat for reps, then switch sides.
claude.safetyNote: Keep the spine neutral during the hinge and row rather than rounding the back.

garmin:POSE:LOW_LUNGE.summary: Low Lunge Pose is a deep lunge posture that lengthens the rear hip while the front knee remains bent.
steps: From standing or a forward fold, step one foot far back.
Bend the front knee over the ankle and extend the rear leg behind you.
Place the hands beside the front foot for support.
Lengthen the chest forward while allowing the hips to settle comfortably.
Hold with steady breathing, then change sides.
garmin:POSE:LOW_LUNGE.safetyNote: Keep the front knee aligned with the foot and reduce the depth if the hips or knee feel strained.

codex.safetyNote: The metadata states that yoga schools use this name for different postures, so the exact twist cannot be determined.

claude.summary: A low lunge with the back knee down and a spinal twist toward the front leg.
steps: From a low lunge with the back knee on the floor, place one hand on the floor inside the front foot.
Root down through the front foot and lengthen the spine.
Rotate the torso toward the front leg, reaching the opposite arm toward the ceiling.
Gaze up past the raised hand and hold.
Return to center, then switch sides.
claude.safetyNote: Twist from the mid-back and stop if you feel pinching in the spine.

codex.summary: A low lunge with inward muscular tension adds an isometric inner-thigh contraction to the hip-opening position.
steps: Take a long split stance and lower into a comfortable low lunge.
Keep the front foot planted and the front knee aligned over the foot.
Without moving the feet, gently draw them toward each other against the floor.
Maintain the inward tension while holding the lunge and breathing normally.
Release the tension, rise carefully, and repeat on the other side.
codex.safetyNote: Apply only moderate inward tension and stop if you feel pain in the groin or knees.

claude.summary: A held low lunge with an isometric squeeze of the inner thighs to engage the adductors.
steps: Step into a low lunge with the front knee bent over the ankle.
Set both feet firmly and keep the torso upright.
Isometrically squeeze the legs toward the midline as if drawing the feet together.
Hold the contraction for the prescribed time while breathing steadily.
Release and switch sides.
claude.safetyNote: Keep the contraction gradual and avoid straining the groin.

codex.summary: This low lunge yoga pose places the rear knee down while the torso and arms rise.
steps: Step one foot forward into a lunge and lower the rear knee to the floor.
Position the front knee above the ankle and point the rear leg comfortably behind you.
Let the hips move forward gently while lifting the torso.
Reach both arms overhead without compressing the lower back.
Hold with steady breathing, then change sides.
codex.safetyNote: Cushion the rear knee as needed and avoid pushing the hips beyond a comfortable stretch.

claude.summary: A crescent low-lunge yoga pose with the back knee resting on the floor and arms raised.
steps: From a lunge, lower the back knee to the floor with the toes untucked.
Bend the front knee to stack it over the ankle.
Press the hips gently forward to open the front of the back hip.
Sweep both arms overhead and lift the chest.
Hold, breathing evenly, then switch sides.
claude.safetyNote: Pad the down knee and avoid overarching the lower back when reaching up.

codex.summary: A low side-to-side lunge shifts the body laterally between bent legs while maintaining a low stance.
steps: Stand with the feet wide and toes pointing comfortably forward or slightly outward.
Bend one knee and shift the hips toward that side while keeping the opposite leg longer.
Stay low as you move through the center.
Shift onto the other leg and bend that knee.
Continue alternating sides with controlled movement.
codex.safetyNote: Keep each bent knee tracking with its toes and do not force the straight leg into an excessive stretch.

claude.summary: A bodyweight lateral lunge shifting the hips low from one side to the other.
steps: Stand with feet wider than shoulder width, toes forward.
Shift your weight to one side, bending that knee into a deep side lunge while the other leg stays straight.
Keep the hips low and chest up.
Shift smoothly across to lunge onto the opposite leg.
Continue alternating side to side for reps.
claude.safetyNote: Keep the bent knee tracking over the toes and stay low rather than bouncing.

codex.safetyNote: A lunge matrix can use several different direction sequences, and this record does not define which one.

claude.summary: A multi-directional lunge sequence stepping forward, laterally, and rotationally to train the hips in several planes.
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Lunge forward with one leg, then return to center.
Lunge laterally to the side with the same leg, then return.
Lunge backward and rotationally, returning to center after each.
Complete the sequence, then repeat leading with the other leg.
claude.safetyNote: Control each direction and keep the working knee aligned over the foot.

codex.safetyNote: The name does not clarify whether this is a split squat, an alternating lunge-to-squat sequence, or another combination.
The record conflicts on whether a dumbbell is used and does not specify the direction or timing of the arm reach.

claude.summary: A lunge combined with an overhead arm reach to extend hip and torso mobility, optionally holding a dumbbell.
steps: Hold a dumbbell (or use bodyweight) and step forward into a lunge.
Lower until both knees approach 90 degrees.
Reach both arms overhead, lengthening the torso tall.
Lower the arms and drive through the front foot to stand.
Repeat, alternating legs.
claude.safetyNote: Avoid arching the lower back as you reach overhead.

codex.summary: This bodyweight lunge adds a diagonal arm reach to mobilize the hips, shoulders, and torso.
steps: Stand tall with the arms relaxed.
Step forward into a lunge and lower under control.
Reach both arms diagonally across and beyond the forward leg while allowing a controlled torso rotation.
Return the arms and torso to center.
Push through the front foot to stand, then repeat on the other side.
codex.safetyNote: Keep the front knee aligned with the toes and make the diagonal reach without twisting the knee.

claude.summary: A bodyweight lunge with both arms reaching diagonally overhead across the body.
steps: Step forward into a lunge, lowering both knees toward 90 degrees.
Reach both arms up and across on a diagonal, away from the front leg.
Feel the stretch through the trunk and hip.
Return the arms to center and press back to standing.
Repeat, alternating legs and reach direction.
claude.safetyNote: Keep the front knee stable and reach from the torso rather than twisting the knee.

codex.safetyNote: The name and metadata do not specify how the dumbbell is held or which direction the torso bends.

claude.summary: A lunge combined with a lateral torso bend, holding a dumbbell to load the obliques.
steps: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and step forward into a lunge.
Lower until both knees approach 90 degrees.
Bend the torso laterally away from the dumbbell to stretch the side.
Return upright and drive through the front foot to stand.
Repeat, then switch sides.
claude.safetyNote: Bend directly to the side without twisting or over-flexing the spine.

garmin:WARM_UP:STRETCH_LUNGE_WITH_SPINAL.summary: Stretch the hips, thighs, and spine by combining a forward lunge with a controlled torso rotation.
steps: Stand tall and step one foot forward into a long stance.
Bend the front knee and lower into a lunge while keeping the back leg extended.
Place the hand opposite the front foot beside that foot.
Rotate your torso toward the front leg and reach the other arm upward.
Pause, return carefully, and repeat on the opposite side.
garmin:WARM_UP:STRETCH_LUNGE_WITH_SPINAL.safetyNote: Keep the front knee aligned with the toes and rotate only within a comfortable range.

garmin:MOVE:LUNGES_WITH_KNEE_LIFT.summary: Perform a forward lunge followed by a balanced knee drive as you return to standing.
steps: Stand tall with your feet about hip-width apart.
Step forward and lower until both knees are comfortably bent.
Push through the front foot to rise.
Bring the rear leg forward and lift its knee toward your chest.
Regain balance, then repeat on the other side.
garmin:MOVE:LUNGES_WITH_KNEE_LIFT.safetyNote: Keep the supporting knee aligned over the foot and use a smaller knee lift if balance is limited.

claude.summary: A forward lunge performed while holding a single dumbbell on one side to add an anti-lateral-flexion core challenge.
steps: Hold one dumbbell at shoulder or at your side on one hand.
Brace your core and keep your torso squared to resist leaning.
Step forward and lower until both knees bend near 90 degrees.
Push through the front heel to return to standing.
Complete the set, then switch the dumbbell to the other side.
claude.safetyNote: Resist tipping toward the loaded side by keeping your shoulders and hips level.

claude.summary: A reverse (backward-stepping) lunge holding a single dumbbell on one side for an offset core challenge.
steps: Hold one dumbbell on one hand at shoulder or at your side.
Brace your core and keep your torso squared and level.
Step one foot backward and lower until both knees bend near 90 degrees.
Drive through the front heel to return to standing.
Finish the set, then switch the dumbbell to the other side.
claude.safetyNote: Control the backward step and resist leaning toward the loaded side.

garmin:LUNGE:OVERHEAD_BULGARIAN_SPLIT_SQ.summary: Perform a rear-foot-elevated split squat while holding a barbell securely overhead.
steps: Place one foot behind you on a bench and set the other foot far enough forward for a stable stance.
Press the barbell overhead with straight, stable arms.
Brace your trunk and lower your hips by bending the front knee.
Descend under control while keeping the front knee aligned with the foot.
Drive through the front foot to stand, then complete the set before switching legs.
garmin:LUNGE:OVERHEAD_BULGARIAN_SPLIT_SQ.safetyNote: Use a light load and stop if you cannot keep the bar stable overhead or the front knee aligned.

garmin:LUNGE:OVERHEAD_DUMBBELL_LUNGE.summary: Perform a forward lunge while maintaining one or more dumbbells in a stable overhead position.
steps: Stand tall and press the dumbbell or dumbbells overhead with your arms extended.
Brace your trunk and step one foot forward.
Lower into a lunge while keeping the weight directly above your shoulders.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Repeat with the opposite leg.
garmin:LUNGE:OVERHEAD_DUMBBELL_LUNGE.safetyNote: Choose a load you can control without arching your lower back or losing overhead stability.

garmin:LUNGE:OVERHEAD_DUMBBELL_REVERSE_L.summary: Step backward into a lunge while holding one or more dumbbells steadily overhead.
steps: Stand tall and press the dumbbell or dumbbells overhead.
Brace your trunk and step one foot backward.
Lower until both knees are comfortably bent while keeping the weight above your shoulders.
Push through the front foot and bring the rear foot forward to stand.
Repeat on the opposite side.
garmin:LUNGE:OVERHEAD_DUMBBELL_REVERSE_L.safetyNote: Keep your ribs controlled and reduce the load if the dumbbell drifts or your back arches.

garmin:LUNGE:OVERHEAD_DUMBBELL_SPLIT_SQU.summary: Lower and rise in a stationary split stance while holding one or more dumbbells overhead.
steps: Take a stable split stance with both feet pointing generally forward.
Press the dumbbell or dumbbells overhead and brace your trunk.
Bend both knees to lower your hips straight down.
Pause at a comfortable depth while keeping the front knee aligned with the foot.
Drive through both feet to rise, then switch legs after completing the set.
garmin:LUNGE:OVERHEAD_DUMBBELL_SPLIT_SQU.safetyNote: Use a manageable load and avoid arching your lower back to hold the weight overhead.

garmin:LUNGE:OVERHEAD_LUNGE.summary: Perform a forward lunge while stabilizing a barbell overhead.
steps: Stand tall and secure the barbell overhead with straight, stable arms.
Brace your trunk and step one foot forward.
Lower into a lunge while keeping the bar above your shoulders.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Repeat with the opposite leg.
garmin:LUNGE:OVERHEAD_LUNGE.safetyNote: Use a light load and stop if shoulder mobility or balance prevents a stable overhead position.

garmin:HYPEREXTENSION:OVERHEAD_LUNGE_WIT.summary: Perform a forward lunge while holding a medicine ball overhead.
steps: Stand tall and hold the medicine ball overhead with both hands.
Brace your trunk and step one foot forward.
Lower into a lunge while keeping the ball above your shoulders.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Repeat with the opposite leg.
garmin:HYPEREXTENSION:OVERHEAD_LUNGE_WIT.safetyNote: Keep the ball controlled and avoid leaning backward or letting the front knee collapse inward.

codex.summary: Perform a barbell overhead lunge with a controlled torso rotation toward the forward leg.
steps: Stabilize the barbell overhead with straight arms and stand tall.
Step one foot forward and lower into a lunge.
Keeping your hips controlled, rotate your upper torso toward the forward leg.
Return your torso to center while maintaining the bar overhead.
Push back to standing and repeat on the opposite side.
codex.safetyNote: Use a very light load and keep the rotation small enough to maintain knee and overhead control.

claude.summary: A forward lunge holding a barbell overhead while adding a torso rotation toward the front leg to engage the obliques.
steps: Press and hold a barbell overhead with arms locked out.
Step forward and lower into a lunge with both knees near 90 degrees.
Rotate your torso toward the front leg while keeping the bar overhead.
Rotate back to center.
Push through the front heel to stand, then alternate legs.
claude.safetyNote: Rotate slowly and only as far as you can keep the bar stable overhead.

claude.summary: A forward lunge performed while pressing a loaded ruck (weighted backpack) overhead for lower-body and overhead stability work.
steps: Grip a loaded ruck and press it overhead with arms locked out.
Brace your core and keep the ruck stacked over your shoulders.
Step forward and lower until both knees bend near 90 degrees.
Push through the front heel to return to standing.
Alternate legs for the prescribed repetitions.
claude.safetyNote: Keep the ruck balanced overhead and lower it under control if your shoulders fatigue.

garmin:MOVE:PSOAS_LUNGE_STRETCH.summary: Stretch the hip flexors by gently shifting the pelvis forward from a lunge position.
steps: Begin in a half-kneeling lunge with one knee down and the opposite foot forward.
Stand through your torso and lightly tuck your pelvis.
Shift your hips forward until you feel a stretch at the front of the kneeling-side hip.
Hold the position without arching your lower back.
Ease out and repeat on the opposite side.
garmin:MOVE:PSOAS_LUNGE_STRETCH.safetyNote: Use padding under the rear knee if needed and stop before you feel pinching in the hip or back.

claude.summary: A backward-stepping lunge onto a box while holding a barbell across the back.
steps: Set a barbell across your upper back and stand in front of a box.
Step one foot backward onto the box behind you.
Lower until the front thigh is near parallel to the floor.
Drive through the front heel to return to standing.
Complete the reps, then switch legs.
claude.safetyNote: Make sure the box is stable and place the rear foot securely before descending.

claude.summary: A bodyweight backward-stepping lunge that places the rear foot onto a box behind you.
steps: Stand in front of a box.
Step one foot backward onto the box behind you.
Lower until the front thigh is near parallel to the floor.
Push through the front heel to return to standing.
Complete the reps, then switch legs.
claude.safetyNote: Confirm the box is stable and set the rear foot securely before lowering.

claude.summary: A backward-stepping lunge onto a box while holding a dumbbell in each hand.
steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides and stand in front of a box.
Step one foot backward onto the box behind you.
Lower until the front thigh is near parallel to the floor.
Drive through the front heel to return to standing.
Complete the reps, then switch legs.
claude.safetyNote: Ensure the box is stable and keep the weights controlled at your sides.

codex.summary: Hold dumbbells while stepping one leg backward and across the body into a curtsy-style lunge.
steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step one foot backward and diagonally behind the standing leg.
Bend both knees and lower under control while keeping your torso upright.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Repeat on the opposite side.
codex.safetyNote: Keep the front knee tracking with the foot and limit the crossover if it causes knee or hip discomfort.

claude.summary: A curtsy-style reverse lunge holding dumbbells, stepping the rear leg back and across the body's midline.
steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step one foot backward and diagonally across behind your standing leg.
Lower until the front thigh is near parallel, keeping the front knee tracking forward.
Drive through the front heel to return to standing.
Alternate sides for the prescribed repetitions.
claude.safetyNote: Keep the front knee aligned over the foot and avoid letting it collapse inward.

codex.summary: Hold dumbbells while stepping backward on a diagonal into a controlled lunge.
steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step one foot backward and outward on a diagonal.
Bend both knees to lower into the angled lunge.
Push through the front foot to return to the starting position.
Repeat on the opposite side.
codex.safetyNote: Keep each knee aligned with its foot and shorten the diagonal step if you lose balance.

claude.summary: A reverse lunge holding dumbbells where the rear foot steps backward on a diagonal to target the glutes at an angle.
steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step one foot backward and out to a diagonal behind you.
Lower until the front thigh is near parallel to the floor.
Push through the front heel to return to standing.
Alternate legs for the prescribed repetitions.
claude.safetyNote: Keep the front knee tracking over the foot as you angle backward.

codex.summary: Combine a backward lunge with an overhead reach toward the rear to open the front of the body.
steps: Stand tall with your arms relaxed.
Step one foot backward and lower into a reverse lunge.
Raise your arms and reach upward and slightly back without collapsing your lower back.
Bring your arms and torso back to neutral.
Push through the front foot to stand, then repeat on the opposite side.
codex.safetyNote: Keep the backward reach gentle and stop if it causes discomfort in your lower back or shoulders.

claude.summary: A bodyweight backward-stepping lunge combined with an overhead arm reach back to add a shoulder and thoracic stretch.
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot backward and lower into a reverse lunge.
At the bottom, reach both arms overhead and slightly back.
Return the arms and drive through the front heel to stand.
Alternate legs for the prescribed repetitions.
claude.safetyNote: Reach back only as far as you can control without overarching your lower back.

codex.summary: Combine a reverse lunge with a controlled torso twist and overhead reach.
steps: Stand tall and step one foot backward into a reverse lunge.
Raise your arms overhead while keeping your trunk braced.
Rotate your torso toward the forward leg within a comfortable range.
Return your torso and arms to center.
Push through the front foot to stand, then repeat on the opposite side.
codex.safetyNote: Keep the front knee aligned with the foot and avoid forcing the twist or arching your lower back.

claude.summary: A bodyweight reverse lunge that combines a torso twist toward the front leg with an overhead reach to engage the obliques and shoulders.
steps: Step one foot backward and lower into a reverse lunge.
Rotate your torso toward the front leg.
Reach both arms overhead as you unwind, extending tall.
Return to center and drive through the front heel to stand.
Alternate legs for the prescribed repetitions.
claude.safetyNote: Move through the twist and reach smoothly, keeping the front knee stable over the foot.

claude.summary: A reverse lunge in which the rear foot slides back off a box on a gliding disc to increase range and control.
steps: Stand tall with one foot on a box and the other foot behind it resting on a sliding disc.
Brace your core and keep the front foot planted flat on the box.
Slide the rear foot backward along the floor as you lower into a lunge, bending the front knee.
Descend until the front thigh is near parallel and the rear knee lowers toward the floor.
Drive through the front heel and slide the rear foot back up to the start.
claude.safetyNote: Keep the front knee tracking over the toes and control the slide so you don't overshoot the split.

garmin:LUNGE:REVERSE_SLIDING_LUNGE.summary: A reverse lunge performed by sliding one foot backward on a sliding disc while the front leg controls the movement.
steps: Stand tall with one foot centered on the sliding disc.
Brace your torso and slide that foot straight backward.
Bend the front knee and lower your hips until reaching a comfortable lunge depth.
Press through the front foot while sliding the rear foot forward to stand.
Complete the repetitions, then switch sides.
garmin:LUNGE:REVERSE_SLIDING_LUNGE.safetyNote: Keep the front knee aligned with the toes and control the disc throughout.

claude.summary: A yoga lunge pose with one foot forward and the back leg extended to open the hips and stretch the hamstrings.
steps: From a low lunge, place the front foot flat and extend the back leg straight behind you.
Keep the hands framing or resting beside the front foot.
Lengthen the spine and press the chest forward over the front thigh.
Shift the hips back slightly toward the rear leg to deepen the hamstring stretch.
Hold, breathing steadily, then switch sides.
claude.safetyNote: Ease into the stretch gradually and avoid forcing the hips past a comfortable range.

codex.summary: This movement transitions from a deep runner's lunge into a single-leg standing balance.
steps: Begin in a runner's lunge with one foot forward, the opposite leg extended back, and your torso long.
Shift your weight into the front foot and begin rising.
Drive the rear knee forward and upward as you straighten the standing leg.
Pause upright while balancing on the standing leg.
Step back into the runner's lunge and repeat before switching sides.
codex.safetyNote: Use a controlled transition and keep the standing knee aligned over the foot.

claude.summary: A dynamic lunge that transitions into a single-leg balance by driving the rear knee up.
steps: Start in a lunge with one foot forward, weight in the front leg.
Brace your core and press through the front foot.
Drive the rear knee up and forward as you rise onto the standing front leg.
Balance on the standing leg with the opposite knee lifted to hip height.
Lower the lifted leg back into the lunge and repeat, then switch sides.
claude.safetyNote: Fix your gaze on a point ahead to steady the balance and avoid wobbling the knee.

codex.summary: A sandbag lunge strengthens the legs while the upper body stabilizes the securely held load.
steps: Stand tall while holding the sandbag securely close to your body.
Step one foot forward and plant it firmly.
Bend both knees to lower into a lunge while keeping your torso upright.
Press through the front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs or complete the repetitions before switching sides.
codex.safetyNote: Keep the sandbag secure and avoid letting the front knee collapse inward.

claude.summary: A forward lunge performed while holding a sandbag to load the lower body.
steps: Hold a sandbag against the chest or across the shoulders and stand tall.
Brace your core and step one foot forward.
Bend both knees to lower until the front thigh is near parallel and the rear knee nears the floor.
Drive through the front heel to return to standing.
Repeat, alternating or completing reps per side.
claude.safetyNote: Keep the torso upright and the front knee tracking over the toes.

codex.summary: A sandbag rotational lunge combines a lunging step with controlled trunk and sandbag rotation toward the working side.
steps: Stand holding the sandbag securely in front of your torso.
Step into a lunge and lower under control.
Rotate your torso and move the sandbag toward the side of the forward leg.
Return the sandbag and torso to center.
Press through the forward foot to stand, then repeat on the other side.
codex.safetyNote: Rotate through the upper torso without twisting or collapsing the planted knee.

claude.summary: A lunge holding a sandbag while rotating the torso over the front leg to engage the obliques.
steps: Hold a sandbag at chest height and stand tall with feet hip-width.
Step one foot forward and bend both knees into a lunge.
At the bottom, rotate your torso toward the front leg, keeping the sandbag in front of you.
Rotate back to center.
Push through the front heel to stand, then repeat and switch sides.
claude.safetyNote: Rotate from the trunk in a controlled manner and keep the front knee stable.

codex.summary: A sandbag side lunge loads the hips and legs as you step laterally while holding a sandbag.
steps: Stand tall while holding the sandbag securely close to your body.
Take a wide step to one side with both feet pointing generally forward.
Push your hips back and bend the stepping knee while keeping the opposite leg long.
Press through the stepping foot to return to standing.
Complete the repetitions, then switch sides.
codex.safetyNote: Keep the bent knee tracking with the toes and maintain control of the sandbag.

claude.summary: A lateral lunge performed while holding a sandbag to load the hips and inner thighs.
steps: Hold a sandbag at the chest and stand with feet together.
Step one foot out wide to the side, keeping both feet pointing forward.
Bend the stepping-side knee and push the hips back, keeping the other leg straight.
Lower until the bent thigh is near parallel while the trailing leg stays extended.
Push off the bent leg to return to standing, then repeat on the other side.
claude.safetyNote: Keep the trailing leg straight and the working knee aligned over the foot.

codex.summary: A shifting side lunge transfers the hips between bent-knee positions on alternating sides without fully standing between them.
steps: Take a wide stance with your feet pointing generally forward.
Push your hips back and bend one knee, keeping the opposite leg long.
Stay low as you shift your hips through the center.
Bend the opposite knee while straightening the first leg.
Continue shifting smoothly from side to side.
codex.safetyNote: Keep each bent knee aligned with its toes and move only through a comfortable range.

claude.summary: A lateral lunge in which weight shifts side to side between legs without fully returning to center.
steps: Stand with feet wide, toes pointing forward.
Shift your weight to one side, bending that knee and pushing the hips back into a side lunge.
Keep the opposite leg extended and its foot flat.
Shift your weight across to the other side, straightening the first leg and bending the other.
Continue alternating side to side in a smooth shifting motion.
claude.safetyNote: Keep both feet flat and knees tracking over the toes as you shift weight.

codex.summary: This combination alternates a lateral lunge with a crossover lunge to challenge the hips and legs in different directions.
steps: Stand tall with your feet under your hips.
Step one foot sideways and lower into a side lunge.
Press through that foot to return to standing.
Move the same leg across the other leg and lower into a controlled crossover lunge.
Return to standing and repeat before switching sides.
codex.safetyNote: Keep each planted knee tracking with the toes and avoid forcing the crossover depth.

claude.summary: A combination lunge alternating a lateral lunge with a crossover (curtsy) lunge on the same leg.
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width.
Step one foot out to the side into a lateral lunge, bending that knee and keeping the other leg straight.
Push back to center.
Step the same leg behind and across the body into a crossover lunge, bending both knees.
Return to center and repeat the sequence, then switch sides.
claude.safetyNote: Control the crossover step to keep the knees stable and avoid twisting them.

garmin:LUNGE:SIDE_LUNGE.summary: A side lunge strengthens the hips and legs by shifting the body over one bent leg while the other remains long.
steps: Stand tall with your feet under your hips.
Take a wide step to one side with both feet pointing generally forward.
Push your hips back and bend the stepping knee while keeping the opposite leg long.
Press through the stepping foot to return to standing.
Repeat on the same side or alternate sides.
garmin:LUNGE:SIDE_LUNGE.safetyNote: Keep the bent knee aligned with the toes and the stepping foot fully grounded.

claude.summary: A lateral lunge combined with an overhead press performed as you rise.
steps: Stand tall holding your load at shoulder height and feet together.
Step one foot out to the side and bend that knee into a lateral lunge.
Keep the opposite leg straight and torso upright.
Drive through the bent leg to return to standing while pressing the load overhead.
Lower the load back to the shoulders and repeat, then switch sides.
claude.safetyNote: Brace the core during the press and keep the working knee tracking over the toes.

codex.summary: An explosive side lunge that finishes by driving off the lunging leg into a lateral or upward jump.
steps: Stand tall with your feet under your hips.
Step to one side and lower into a side lunge.
Drive forcefully through the bent leg to leave the floor.
Land softly with the knee slightly bent and regain control.
Repeat as programmed, then switch sides.
codex.safetyNote: Land quietly with the knee aligned over the foot and stop if control deteriorates.

claude.summary: An explosive lateral lunge that finishes by jumping off the working leg.
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width.
Step one foot out wide and lower into a lateral lunge.
Load the bent leg by pushing the hips back.
Explosively drive off the bent leg to jump up and toward center.
Land softly and repeat, alternating sides.
claude.safetyNote: Land with soft, bent knees to absorb impact and keep the knee aligned over the foot.

codex.summary: A side lunge stretch lengthens the inner thigh by shifting the hips over one bent leg while the other leg stays straight.
steps: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder width and toes pointing generally forward.
Shift your hips toward one side and bend that knee.
Keep the opposite leg straight and both feet grounded.
Hold briefly while breathing normally.
Return through the center and repeat on the other side.
codex.safetyNote: Use a comfortable depth and do not force the straight leg or groin.

claude.summary: A static lateral lunge stretch to open the hips and adductors as a warm-up.
steps: Stand with feet wider than shoulder-width, toes forward.
Shift your weight to one side, bending that knee and pushing the hips back.
Keep the opposite leg straight to feel a stretch along the inner thigh.
Hold the position, keeping both feet flat.
Return to center and repeat on the other side.
claude.safetyNote: Ease into the stretch gently and keep the bent knee behind the toes.

claude.summary: A lateral lunge that transitions into sweeping the trailing leg through as you rise.
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width.
Step one foot out to the side into a lateral lunge, bending that knee.
Push off the bent leg to return toward standing.
As you rise, sweep the working leg up and across in front of the body.
Lower the leg and repeat, then switch sides.
claude.safetyNote: Control the sweep to maintain balance and avoid straining the standing knee.

codex.summary: This movement links a side lunge with a controlled crossover toe tap for lateral strength and balance.
steps: Stand tall with your feet under your hips.
Step one foot sideways and lower into a side lunge.
Press through the lunging foot to rise.
Bring that foot across the standing leg and lightly tap the floor.
Move directly into the next repetition, then switch sides.
codex.safetyNote: Keep the standing knee aligned with the foot and make the crossover tap light and controlled.

claude.summary: A lateral lunge followed by tapping the working foot behind and across the body.
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width.
Step one foot out to the side into a lateral lunge.
Push off to return toward standing.
Bring the same foot behind and across the body to tap the floor in a crossover position.
Return to standing and repeat, then switch sides.
claude.safetyNote: Keep the standing knee stable as you reach across for the tap.

codex.summary: Side-to-side lunge chops combine alternating lateral lunges with a diagonal chopping motion of the arms.
steps: Take a wide stance and extend your arms together in front of you.
Shift into a side lunge while sweeping your arms diagonally toward that side.
Stay braced as you pass through the center.
Shift into the opposite side lunge and chop your arms toward the other side.
Continue alternating with controlled rhythm.
codex.safetyNote: Turn through the torso without twisting the knees, and keep each bent knee aligned with its toes.

claude.summary: A side-to-side lateral lunge combined with a chopping arm motion to engage the core.
steps: Stand with feet wide, hands clasped or holding a load in front.
Shift into a lateral lunge on one side, bending that knee.
Chop the arms down toward the bent leg as you lunge.
Push back and shift into a lateral lunge on the other side, chopping toward that leg.
Continue alternating side to side.
claude.safetyNote: Rotate through the trunk under control and keep the lunging knee over the foot.

codex.summary: A Siff jump lunge is an alternating jump lunge performed while staying high on the balls of the feet to emphasize the calves.
steps: Take a split stance and rise onto the balls of both feet.
Lower into a shallow lunge without allowing the heels to settle.
Jump upward and switch the legs in the air.
Land softly on the balls of the feet in the opposite split stance.
Immediately lower under control and continue alternating.
codex.safetyNote: Maintain ankle control and use a smaller range if you cannot land softly without the heels collapsing.

codex.summary: This exercise combines a dumbbell reverse lunge with a one-arm overhead press.
steps: Stand tall holding one dumbbell at shoulder height in one hand.
Step the opposite foot backward and lower into a reverse lunge.
Press through the front foot to rise as you press the dumbbell overhead.
Lower the dumbbell to shoulder height with control.
Repeat the repetitions, then switch the working arm and leg arrangement.
codex.safetyNote: Keep your torso braced, the front knee aligned with the toes, and the dumbbell under control overhead.

claude.summary: A reverse lunge holding a dumbbell in one hand, pressing it overhead as you stand.
steps: Hold a dumbbell in one hand at shoulder height and stand tall.
Step the opposite foot back into a reverse lunge, lowering the rear knee toward the floor.
Drive through the front heel to stand while pressing the dumbbell overhead.
Lower the dumbbell back to the shoulder as you set up the next rep.
Complete reps, then switch the dumbbell and legs.
claude.safetyNote: Brace the core to keep the torso upright during the single-arm press.

garmin:LUNGE:SLIDING_LATERAL_LUNGE.summary: A sliding lateral lunge keeps one foot on a sliding disc as it glides sideways while the supporting leg bends.
steps: Stand tall with one foot centered on the sliding disc.
Shift your weight onto the stationary leg and slide the other foot sideways.
Push your hips back and bend the stationary knee while keeping the sliding leg long.
Press through the stationary foot and draw the disc back inward to stand.
Complete the repetitions, then switch sides.
garmin:LUNGE:SLIDING_LATERAL_LUNGE.safetyNote: Control the disc, keep the supporting knee aligned with the toes, and avoid sliding beyond a stable range.

garmin:SUSPENSION:LUNGE.summary: Perform a supported forward lunge while holding the suspension handles.
steps: Stand facing the anchor and hold one handle in each hand with light strap tension.
Step one foot forward while keeping your torso upright.
Bend both knees to lower into a lunge.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Repeat on the other side.
garmin:SUSPENSION:LUNGE.safetyNote: Keep the front knee aligned with the toes and maintain controlled strap tension.

garmin:SUSPENSION:SIDE_LUNGE.summary: Use suspension handles for support while lunging laterally into one hip.
steps: Face the anchor, hold both handles, and stand with your feet together.
Step one foot widely to the side.
Bend the stepping knee and push that hip back while keeping the other leg straight.
Push through the bent leg to return to standing.
Repeat on the other side.
garmin:SUSPENSION:SIDE_LUNGE.safetyNote: Keep the bent knee tracking over the foot and both feet planted.

garmin:PLYO:WEIGHTED_ALTERNATING_JUMP_LU.summary: Alternate lunge positions with an explosive jump while holding dumbbells.
steps: Stand in a split stance with a dumbbell in each hand.
Lower into a lunge with both knees bent.
Jump vertically and switch your legs in the air.
Land softly in the opposite split stance.
Immediately lower under control and continue alternating.
garmin:PLYO:WEIGHTED_ALTERNATING_JUMP_LU.safetyNote: Use manageable weights and stop if you cannot land softly with stable knees.

garmin:LUNGE:WEIGHTED_CURTSY_LUNGE.summary: Hold dumbbells while stepping one leg diagonally behind the other into a curtsy lunge.
steps: Stand tall holding the dumbbells at your sides.
Step one foot diagonally behind and across the standing leg.
Bend both knees and lower your hips while keeping your torso upright.
Press through the front foot to return to standing.
Repeat on the opposite side.
garmin:LUNGE:WEIGHTED_CURTSY_LUNGE.safetyNote: Keep the front knee aligned with its toes and avoid forcing an excessive crossover.

claude.summary: A standard forward lunge performed while wearing a weighted vest for added load.
steps: Wear a weighted vest and stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Step forward with one leg, keeping the torso upright.
Lower until the front thigh is near parallel and the back knee drops toward the floor.
Push through the front heel to return to standing.
Repeat, alternating or completing reps per leg.
claude.safetyNote: Keep the front knee tracking over the toes and maintain a neutral spine.

claude.summary: A sequence of lunges performed in multiple directions (forward, lateral, and reverse) while holding dumbbells.
steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand, standing tall with feet hip-width apart.
Lunge forward with one leg, then return to center.
Lunge laterally to the same side, then return to center.
Lunge diagonally back or in reverse, then return to center.
Complete the sequence, then repeat on the other leg.
claude.safetyNote: Keep each working knee aligned over the foot and control the return between directions.

codex.summary: Step backward into a dumbbell-loaded reverse lunge while reaching the weight backward.
steps: Stand tall holding a dumbbell securely with both hands.
Step one foot backward and begin bending both knees.
Lower into the reverse lunge while extending the dumbbell backward within a comfortable shoulder range.
Bring the dumbbell back toward your body as you press through the front foot.
Return to standing and alternate legs.
codex.safetyNote: Keep your trunk controlled and do not reach farther than your shoulders comfortably allow.

claude.summary: A reverse lunge combined with an overhead reach back while holding dumbbells.
steps: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step one leg back into a reverse lunge, lowering the back knee toward the floor.
As you descend, reach the dumbbells back and overhead to extend the reach.
Bring the arms down and drive through the front heel to return to standing.
Repeat, then switch legs.
claude.safetyNote: Keep the core braced and avoid overarching the lower back during the reach.

codex.summary: Combine a dumbbell-loaded reverse lunge with a controlled torso twist and overhead reach.
steps: Stand tall and hold a dumbbell securely with both hands.
Step one foot backward and lower into a reverse lunge.
Rotate your torso toward the front leg while reaching the dumbbell overhead.
Return the dumbbell to center and unwind your torso.
Push through the front foot to stand, then repeat on the other side.
codex.safetyNote: Use a light load and keep the movement pain-free through the back and shoulders.

claude.summary: A reverse lunge combined with a torso twist and overhead reach using dumbbells.
steps: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Step one leg back into a reverse lunge.
At the bottom, rotate the torso toward the front leg.
Reach the dumbbells overhead as you untwist and rise.
Return to standing and repeat, then switch legs.
claude.safetyNote: Rotate from the trunk under control and keep the front knee stable over the foot.

claude.summary: A reverse lunge with the back foot on a sliding disc that steps down off a box, while holding dumbbells.
steps: Stand on a box holding a dumbbell in each hand, with one foot on a sliding disc.
Slide the disc foot back and off the box to descend into a reverse lunge.
Lower until the front thigh is near parallel, keeping the torso upright.
Drive through the front leg and slide the foot back onto the box to stand.
Repeat, then switch legs.
claude.safetyNote: Control the slide and step carefully on and off the box to avoid slipping.

codex.summary: Hold dumbbells while sliding one foot backward into a reverse lunge.
steps: Stand with dumbbells at your sides and place one foot on a sliding disc.
Slide that foot backward as you bend the supporting knee.
Lower until you reach a controlled reverse-lunge position.
Press through the stationary foot and slide the rear foot forward.
Complete the repetitions, then switch sides.
codex.safetyNote: Keep most of your weight over the stationary foot and prevent the disc from moving too quickly.

claude.summary: A reverse lunge with the back foot gliding on a sliding disc while holding dumbbells.
steps: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand with one foot on a sliding disc.
Slide the disc foot straight back while bending the front knee.
Lower into a lunge until the front thigh is near parallel.
Pull the disc foot back in, driving through the front leg to stand.
Repeat, then switch legs.
claude.safetyNote: Keep the front knee over the foot and control the slide throughout the range.

codex.summary: Move from a dumbbell-loaded runner's lunge into a single-leg balance.
steps: Stand holding the dumbbells at your sides.
Step one foot backward and lower into a runner's lunge.
Drive through the front foot as you bring the rear leg forward.
Finish standing on the front leg with the opposite knee lifted.
Pause with control, then step back into the next repetition.
codex.safetyNote: Keep the standing knee softly bent and use a lighter load if balance is unstable.

claude.summary: A lunge that transitions into a single-leg balance with a driving knee, holding dumbbells.
steps: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Step one leg back into a lunge, lowering into a runner's position.
Drive powerfully through the front leg to stand.
Bring the rear knee up and forward into a balanced single-leg stance.
Hold briefly, lower the leg back, and repeat, then switch sides.
claude.safetyNote: Establish balance before adding speed and keep the standing knee slightly bent.

codex.summary: Hold dumbbells while shifting between right and left side-lunge positions from a wide stance.
steps: Take a wide stance and hold the dumbbells securely.
Bend one knee and shift your hips toward that side while keeping the opposite leg straight.
Press through the bent leg and move through the center.
Shift your hips to the other side and bend the opposite knee.
Continue alternating with both feet planted.
codex.safetyNote: Keep each bent knee tracking over its foot and shift only through a comfortable range.

claude.summary: A lateral lunge where weight shifts from side to side over a wide stance while holding dumbbells.
steps: Stand in a wide stance holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Shift your weight over one leg, bending that knee into a side lunge.
Keep the opposite leg straight and torso upright.
Shift your weight across to the other leg into a side lunge on that side.
Continue shifting side to side for the prescribed reps.
claude.safetyNote: Keep the bent knee tracking over the foot and avoid letting it cave inward.

codex.summary: Alternate a dumbbell-loaded side lunge with a crossover lunge.
steps: Stand tall with the dumbbells held securely.
Step one foot to the side and lower into a side lunge.
Push through that foot to return to standing.
Move the same foot diagonally across the other leg and lower into a crossover lunge.
Return to standing, complete the repetitions, and switch sides.
codex.safetyNote: Keep the supporting knee aligned with its toes during both lunge directions.

claude.summary: A combination of a lateral lunge followed by a crossover (curtsy) lunge on the same leg, with dumbbells.
steps: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Step one leg out to the side into a lateral lunge, then return to center.
Step the same leg diagonally behind into a crossover lunge.
Return to center to complete one rep.
Repeat the sequence, then switch legs.
claude.safetyNote: Control the transition between directions and keep knees aligned over the feet.

garmin:LUNGE:WEIGHTED_SIDE_LUNGE.summary: Hold dumbbells while stepping laterally into a side lunge.
steps: Stand tall holding the dumbbells at your sides.
Step one foot widely to the side.
Bend the stepping knee and push your hips back while keeping the other leg straight.
Press through the bent leg to return to standing.
Repeat on the opposite side.
garmin:LUNGE:WEIGHTED_SIDE_LUNGE.safetyNote: Keep the bent knee aligned with the toes and both feet flat.

codex.summary: Combine a dumbbell-loaded side lunge with an overhead press.
steps: Stand holding the dumbbells at shoulder height.
Step one foot laterally and lower into a side lunge.
Push through the bent leg to return toward standing.
Press the dumbbells overhead as you stand tall.
Lower the dumbbells to shoulder height and repeat on the other side.
codex.safetyNote: Avoid arching your lower back during the press and keep the lunging knee aligned.

claude.summary: A lateral lunge combined with an overhead dumbbell press.
steps: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height.
Step to one side into a lateral lunge, bending that knee.
As you push back to center, press the dumbbells overhead.
Lower the dumbbells back to the shoulders.
Repeat, then perform on the other side.
claude.safetyNote: Press with a braced core and avoid overarching the back at lockout.

claude.summary: A lateral lunge with an explosive jump off the working leg, holding dumbbells.
steps: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand, feet together.
Step to one side into a lateral lunge, loading the bent leg.
Push explosively off that leg to jump upward or laterally.
Land softly and absorb into the next lunge.
Repeat, then perform on the other side.
claude.safetyNote: Land softly with a bent knee and keep it aligned over the foot on impact.

claude.summary: A lateral lunge that transitions into a sweeping leg motion across the body, with dumbbells.
steps: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Step to one side into a lateral lunge.
Push back through the bent leg to return to center.
Sweep the working leg across or in front of the body.
Return the foot down and repeat, then switch sides.
claude.safetyNote: Maintain balance during the sweep and keep the standing knee slightly bent.

codex.summary: Move from a dumbbell-loaded side lunge into a controlled crossover toe tap.
steps: Stand holding the dumbbells securely.
Step one foot to the side and lower into a side lunge.
Push through the bent leg and rise onto the opposite supporting leg.
Move the lunging foot across the supporting leg and lightly tap the floor.
Return to the starting position, then switch sides.
codex.safetyNote: Keep the supporting knee stable and make the crossover tap light and controlled.

claude.summary: A lateral lunge that transitions into a crossover foot tap behind the standing leg, with dumbbells.
steps: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Step to one side into a lateral lunge.
Push back to center through the bent leg.
Bring the working leg across and tap the foot behind the standing leg.
Return and repeat, then switch sides.
claude.safetyNote: Keep the standing knee stable and control the crossover to maintain balance.

codex.summary: Shift between weighted side lunges while moving a dumbbell diagonally across the body in a chopping pattern.
steps: Take a wide stance and hold one dumbbell with both hands.
Shift into a side lunge while moving the dumbbell diagonally toward that side.
Press through the bent leg and guide the dumbbell back across the body.
Shift into a side lunge on the opposite side and complete the next chop.
Continue alternating with controlled torso rotation.
codex.safetyNote: Rotate through a comfortable range and keep both knees aligned with their toes.

claude.summary: Alternating lateral lunges combined with a diagonal chopping motion of the dumbbells.
steps: Stand in a wide stance holding a dumbbell (or both) with both hands.
Lunge laterally to one side while chopping the weight down toward that leg.
Push back and shift into a lateral lunge on the other side.
Chop the weight down toward the opposite leg.
Continue alternating side to side for the prescribed reps.
claude.safetyNote: Rotate through the trunk under control and keep each bent knee over the foot.

codex.summary: Perform dumbbell jump lunges while staying elevated on the balls of the feet to emphasize the calves.
steps: Hold the dumbbells at your sides and take a split stance.
Rise onto the balls of both feet and lower into a shallow lunge.
Jump vertically and switch your legs in the air.
Land softly on the balls of your feet in the opposite split stance.
Maintain heel elevation as you continue alternating.
codex.safetyNote: Use light weights and avoid this movement if you cannot maintain stable, soft landings.

garmin:LUNGE:WEIGHTED_SLIDING_LATERAL_LU.summary: A dumbbell-loaded lateral lunge in which one foot slides outward while the standing leg bends.
steps: Stand tall holding a dumbbell securely, with your feet together and core braced.
Shift your weight onto one leg and slowly slide the opposite foot out to the side.
Bend the supporting knee and push your hips back while keeping the sliding leg straight.
Pause when you reach a controlled depth with your chest lifted.
Drive through the supporting foot and slide the other foot inward to return to standing.
Complete the repetitions, then switch sides.
garmin:LUNGE:WEIGHTED_SLIDING_LATERAL_LU.safetyNote: Keep the supporting knee aligned with the toes and use a controlled sliding range.

garmin:LUNGE:WEIGHTED_WALKING_LUNGE.summary: A traveling lunge performed while holding dumbbells for added resistance.
steps: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand with your core braced.
Step forward and plant the entire lead foot.
Lower your hips until both knees are bent comfortably, keeping your torso upright.
Push through the lead foot and bring the rear leg forward.
Continue by lunging forward with the opposite leg.
garmin:LUNGE:WEIGHTED_WALKING_LUNGE.safetyNote: Keep each front knee aligned with its toes and maintain control between steps.

codex.summary: A wide side-lunge yoga pose with one knee deeply bent, the opposite leg extended, and the arms reaching away from the floor.
steps: Begin standing with your feet set wide apart.
Turn toward one side, bend that knee deeply, and lower your hips while keeping the opposite leg straight.
Keep the bent knee aligned with its toes and ground the bent-leg foot.
Lengthen your spine and lift your torso away from the floor.
Extend your arms outward as far as is comfortable and hold the pose.
Rise with control and repeat on the opposite side.
codex.safetyNote: Do not force the depth, and reduce the bend if you feel knee or groin pain.

claude.summary: A wide-stance side lunge yoga pose (Skandasana) that stretches one leg straight while deeply bending the other, with no equipment.
steps: Stand with feet in a wide stance, toes pointing forward or slightly out.
Shift your weight to one side, bending that knee deeply while the opposite leg extends straight.
Keep the extended foot flat and the bent-knee heel grounded, sitting the hips back and down.
Lengthen through the spine and reach the arms forward or overhead for balance.
Press through the bent leg to shift back to center, then repeat to the other side.
claude.safetyNote: Ease into the depth gradually to avoid overstretching the groin and inner thigh.

garmin:LUNGE:WIDE_GRIP_OVERHEAD_BARBELL_.summary: A stationary split squat performed while holding a barbell overhead with a wide grip.
steps: Take a wide grip on the barbell and press it overhead with your arms extended.
Step into a stable split stance and brace your core with your torso upright.
Bend both knees to lower straight down while keeping the barbell balanced overhead.
Stop at a controlled depth with the front knee aligned over the foot.
Drive through the front foot to return to the starting height.
Complete the repetitions, then switch which leg is forward.
garmin:LUNGE:WIDE_GRIP_OVERHEAD_BARBELL_.safetyNote: Use a manageable load and stop if you cannot keep the barbell stable overhead.
